figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicated expression indicating a sense of separation or disconnection
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরিবারের সদস্যরা ছাড়া ছাড়া হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The family members have become disconnected from each other.
note: This idiom reflects contemporary social fragmentation in Bengali culture, often used in discussions of urbanization and individualism.
